title: Reuse locked workflow identity within source batches
goal: Remove repeated same-root Git metadata queries while rechecking batch boundaries and every source worktree.
checkpoint: Workflow-context tests 2/2 and ship regressions 18/18 passed (77.44s); Luna review, Clippy and fmt passed. Ready for full native gate.
measurements: Ten-agent Trace2 common-dir queries: 96 before, 79 after; total rev-parse 233 before, 216 after. Instrumented wall times 96.68s and 99.99s are not a speedup.
Untraced old/new/new/old samples: 60.53s, 50.27s, 55.31s, 60.40s. Two samples per version under variable host load; first old partly overlapped Clippy. No broad performance guarantee.
Each claimant still resolves its worktree common directory live; root checked before and after each batch; no commit/update_scopes cache.
Foreign workflow, root Git-file redirection and claimant Git-file redirection tests passed in 10.94s; no publish and claims retained.
